summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $4.05/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $4.05 a gallon across Wisconsin as of September 16, 2026, according to GasBuddy — the highest since May 29. AAA figures put the statewide average 14¢ higher than a week ago, 21¢ higher than a month ago, and $1.22 higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Milwaukee ($3.84) and the highest in Superior ($4.30).
